motions.name: Relaxed breathing idle
motions.prompt: A relaxed person stands naturally, breathing gently with subtle asymmetric weight shifts, small shoulder settling, and occasional quiet head movement. The motion stays in place and returns smoothly toward the starting pose.

motions.name: Curious listening idle
motions.prompt: A person listens with friendly curiosity, standing in place with a soft weight shift, a slight head tilt, tiny posture adjustments, and relaxed hands. Natural understated idle motion.

motions.name: Confident idle
motions.prompt: A confident person stands comfortably in place, shoulders open, breathing naturally, shifting weight slowly from one leg to the other with restrained head and hand motion.

motions.name: Tired idle
motions.prompt: A tired person stands in place with slightly lowered shoulders, slow breathing, a small sway, and occasional subtle recovery of posture without walking.

motions.name: Calm explanation
motions.prompt: A person calmly explains an idea while standing, using small open-handed conversational gestures, natural pauses, light head nods, and relaxed posture. No walking.

motions.name: Enthusiastic conversation
motions.prompt: A person speaks enthusiastically while standing, with expressive but believable two-handed gestures, lively posture changes, friendly nods, and clear conversational rhythm.

motions.name: Thoughtful conversation
motions.prompt: A thoughtful speaker pauses, considers their words, makes restrained one-handed explanatory gestures, lightly tilts the head, and resumes speaking while staying in place.

motions.name: Warm laugh
motions.prompt: A person breaks into a warm genuine laugh, shoulders and torso responding naturally, briefly leaning back and then settling into a relaxed standing posture.

motions.name: Small giggle
motions.prompt: A person gives a small amused giggle, briefly drawing the shoulders in, making a modest hand motion, then returning to a comfortable neutral stance.

motions.name: Friendly smile greeting
motions.prompt: A person notices a friend, brightens visibly, gives a small friendly nod and gentle open-palmed greeting, then settles naturally.

motions.name: Friendly wave
motions.prompt: A person raises the right hand and gives a relaxed friendly wave with natural elbow, shoulder, torso, and weight-shift follow-through, then lowers the arm.

motions.name: Agreeing nod
motions.prompt: A standing person gives a clear but natural agreeing nod with a small sympathetic posture response, then returns to attentive neutral.

motions.name: Casual shrug
motions.prompt: A person makes a casual uncertain shrug with both shoulders and open hands, slight head tilt, and natural weight shift, then relaxes.

motions.name: Relaxed walk
motions.prompt: A relaxed person walks forward at a comfortable everyday pace with natural arm swing, stable foot plants, and gentle torso counter-rotation.

motions.name: Purposeful walk
motions.prompt: A person walks forward purposefully with a brisk consistent stride, focused posture, natural arm swing, and firm clean foot contacts.

motions.name: Careful sneak
motions.prompt: A person moves forward quietly and cautiously, knees softened, steps carefully placed, torso alert, and arms balancing naturally.

motions.name: Easy jog
motions.prompt: A person jogs forward at an easy sustainable pace with rhythmic arm drive, soft landings, steady cadence, and believable full-body bounce.

motions.name: Athletic sprint
motions.prompt: An athletic person sprints forward powerfully with strong knee drive, coordinated arm pumping, forward lean, fast cadence, and clean foot contacts.

motions.name: Panicked run
motions.prompt: A frightened person runs forward urgently with quick uneven energy, tense shoulders, protective glances, strong arm motion, and believable footfalls.

motions.name: Freestyle swim
motions.prompt: A swimmer performs a coordinated freestyle front crawl, alternating long arm strokes with torso roll and rhythmic flutter kicks, moving forward horizontally.

motions.name: Breaststroke swim
motions.prompt: A swimmer performs steady breaststroke cycles with symmetrical arm sweeps, frog kicks, body extension, and believable recovery timing.

motions.name: Sit into chair
motions.prompt: A standing person carefully sits down onto a chair behind them, bending naturally through hips and knees, balancing with the torso, and settling comfortably.

motions.name: Stand from chair
motions.prompt: A seated person leans forward, pushes through the feet, stands up smoothly with believable balance, and settles into a neutral standing posture.

motions.name: Pick up object
motions.prompt: A person notices a small object on the floor, bends and reaches down with the right hand, picks it up carefully, and rises back to standing.

motions.name: Put on backpack
motions.prompt: A person lifts a backpack, threads both arms through the shoulder straps, makes small adjustments at the shoulders, and settles it comfortably on the back.

motions.name: Phone chat
motions.prompt: A person holds a phone naturally in the right hand, glances at it while talking, gestures lightly with the free hand, and shifts posture conversationally.

motions.name: Casual dance groove
motions.prompt: A person performs a relaxed rhythmic dance groove with coordinated steps, torso bounce, loose arms, changing weight, and a friendly social energy.

motions.name: Celebrate a win
motions.prompt: A person realizes they have won, throws both arms up, makes an excited full-body celebration, then comes back down smiling and energized.

motions.name: Upper-body stretch
motions.prompt: A person performs a gentle standing upper-body stretch, reaching both arms upward, lengthening the torso, rolling the shoulders, and relaxing.

motions.name: Yawn and stretch
motions.prompt: A sleepy person yawns and gives a natural full-body standing stretch with arms overhead, torso extension, and a relaxed return to neutral.
